title: Disable Virtualization Security
name: virtualization-off
modal: This turns off Virtualization-Based Security and Hypervisor Code Integrity. Games gain FPS, but Windows loses security hardening. Do not apply if you use virtual machines, WSL2 or Docker.
description: Turns off VBS and HVCI virtualization security to free CPU for games
deepDescription:
Virtualization-Based Security costs CPU time in games. This disables it from Windows:

- VirtualizationBasedSecurity → Off
- Hypervisor Code Integrity → Off

Restart required. For the full effect also disable SVM (AMD) or VT-d (Intel) in BIOS. Revert restores protection.
warning: Lowers Windows security. Needs a restart.
